thread:
Ana: Heads-up — GTN asks for a short playbook we can hand off when a new model passes evals. Need cost-vs-quality guidance + a few deterministic heuristics they can use in prioritization. Can someone draft a concise version?
Sam: I can. Thinking a 1-page checklist + tiny scorecard (latency, token-cost, pass-rate on critical prompts).
Jules: GTN needs clear yes/no gates they can explain to customers. Not too ML-y. Give them fallback options and conservative rollouts.
Mike: From SEs: include recommended pricing tiers (e.g., default, high-precision, low-cost) tied to quant & routing. Also a short snippet for product to drop into docs.
Eva: I'll add the eval guardrails: sample size, key buckets, and regression triggers. Suggest minimum 2k prompts across intents, stratified by length and entity density.
Ana: Perfect. Aim for heuristics like: "If latency p95 > 600ms on baseline traffic -> no GTN launch" and "If generation regression >= 3% on critical QA -> require re-run or rollback".
Sam: Drafting quick heuristics now. Inline config example for routing flags:
```
route_policy:
  - name: default
    model: model-v1
    quant: int8
    max_latency_ms: 400
    cost_multiplier: 1.0
  - name: high-precision
    model: model-v1
    quant: fp16
    max_latency_ms: 700
    cost_multiplier: 2.3
```
Sam: Also adding unit-econ rules: compute cost / 1k tokens, expected uplift in CTR or retention, simple ROI calc. Example: if model cost adds $0.005 per active MAU and expected revenue impact < $0.01 then OK.
Jules: Love the ROI framing. Can you make a one-line template: "Expected revenue impact vs incremental model cost = go/no-go"? GTN will paste that into the customer brief.
Mike: For rollouts: recommend three-stage flow: internal canary (5%), external beta (25%), GA (100%) with automatic fallback to previous quant variant on regressions. Include flag triggers: latency spike >20% or regression on golden set >1.5%.
Eva: Golden set should be small and precise (200 prompts) covering safety, hallucination anchors, and functional correctness. Use both unit and integrated prompts. We'll version it so GTN sees stable signal.
Ana: Add operational checklist items: dashboard links (cost per token, latency p95, model-change deploy id), owner's pager, and a short troubleshooting play: 
- If token cost >> expected: check batching & quant config
- If hallucination regressions: run back-compare with previous model on failing prompts
- If latency regressions: try int8 fallback or region routing

Sam: Quick suggested scorecard (0-10 normalized each):
- Latency (p95): 0-10
- Token cost per 1k: 0-10
- Quality (golden set pass %): 0-10
- Safety/regressions: 0-10
Total >= 32 -> Recommend GTN launch, 25-31 -> Beta only, <25 -> Hold.
Jules: Those bands are actionable. Can we also output a one-sentence blurb per band for GTN comms? (e.g., "Beta: good cost, slight regressions on long-form — recommend limited audience").
Sam: Adding canned blurbs. Also attaching short checklist for SE pricing: include suggested margins and a phrase customers can use: "Use high-precision tier for mission-critical flows; use default int8 for cost-sensitive endpoints."
Mike: Can someone add a tiny example handoff doc snippet? GTN likes copy-paste.
Sam: Draft snippet: 
"Model handoff: model-v1-int8. Scorecard: 34/40. Recommended tier: default (int8). Known issues: slight drop on multi-turn long-dialog (>5 turns). Rollout plan: 5%->25%->100% with auto-fallback. Contact: Ana + Mike."
Eva: I'll maintain the golden set and the regression dashboard. I'll also add instructions for how GTN can trigger a quick re-eval (run 2k sample +/- new prompts).
Ana: Awesome. If folks are good with this, I'll compile into a 1-page playbook + a copy-paste snippet for GTN docs. Can we ship by EOD tomorrow? :rocket:
Jules: EOD tomorrow works. I'll schedule a 15-min sync with GTN to walk through the blurb after you post it.
deploy-bot: Canary deployment started for model-v1-int8 -> 5% traffic (deploy id: d-2026-07-15-88).
Ana: Thanks — I'll attach the playbook and the scorecard template in #gtn-handovers once finalized.
Mike: Thx team. I'll prep the pricing table and examples for customers.
Sam: Uploading draft in 15.
Ana: Closing loop — this thread will be the source. We'll iterate after GTN feedback. :white_check_mark:
